title: 第9章 实力大涨第10章 发现矿脉
content_zh:
夜里，陆宸再次行动了。
念及旧情，他没有对陆家仅剩的十一家商铺动手，而是选择了刚刚被林家接管的陆家商铺。
两个时辰过去，陆宸洗劫了四个商铺，从四个商铺和看守的武者身上得到了两百三十二块灵晶。
完事后，陆宸回到了房间，继续修行起来。
因为武道越高，武道突破所需要的灵气越多，这一夜，陆宸只突破了一个阴丹，阳丹并没有突破。
在用完所有灵晶后，陆宸像前几天一样修炼炼魂诀提升魂力，以最短的时间提升自身实力。
清晨
当陆宸精神奕奕的回到房间时，陆战端着饭菜来了，一进门，他就讲着昨夜天元城发生的大事。
“宸哥，听说那个刺客昨夜又出来行凶了，而且是一夜之间洗劫了四个商铺，现在整个天元城都被惊动了。”
陆战一边给陆宸喂饭，一边说道。
陆宸笑着装傻道：“战弟，一夜被洗劫了四个商铺，大房和二房不得气得背过去？”
陆战怨恨道：“我倒是想看大房和二房气得背过去，可惜对方昨夜洗劫的不是大房和二房的商铺。”
陆宸“好奇”
道：“战弟，昨天你不是说今夜轮到陆家了吗，急得大房和二房都增派人员去守了。”
陆战道：“没有洗劫大房和二房的十一家商铺，昨夜那个刺客洗劫的是我们以前的商铺。”
陆宸道：“好家伙，林家刚接手我们的商铺，估计高兴劲都还没过吧，现在就被洗劫了，也是有点疼。”
陆战愤怒道：“他们那么欺负你，比大房和二房都要可恶，那个刺客最好是把林家所有商铺都洗劫了。”
陆宸道：“应该会的。”
“不会了。”
陆战泄气的摇了摇头。

陆宸追问道：“战弟，为什么不会了？”
陆战道：“我听说这件事闹得满城皆知了，现在城主府已经派人调查，那个刺客估计是不敢作案了。”
“这样啊！”
陆宸露出若有所思的表情。
他现在阴丹已突破七重武徒境，全力一战，收拾中阶武士境没有问题，就是高阶武士境也可一战。
但城主府是天元城霸主，他们既然派人调查，出动的武者必是武师，而且估计不止一个人。
陆战带来的这个消息让他意识到得消停一下了，要不然一旦被逮到，那就成为天元城公敌了。
“宸哥，宸哥，……”
就在陆宸想着接下来应该怎么办时，陆战的声音再耳旁想起，等到陆宸回过神时，陆战一只手不停的在眼前晃。
陆宸道：“什么？”
陆战道：“宸哥，你在想什么，居然这么入神，我叫了你好几声，你居然都没有回答我。”
content_en:
At night, Lu Chen took action again.
Thinking of his old friendship, he did not take action on the eleven remaining stores of the Lu family, but chose the Lu family store that had just been taken over by the Lin family.
Two hours later, Lu Chen looted four shops and obtained 232 spiritual crystals from the four shops and the warriors guarding them.
After finishing, Lu Chen returned to the room and continued to practice.
Because the higher the martial arts, the more spiritual energy is needed to break through. On this night, Lu Chen only broke through one Yin Dan, but not the Yang Dan.
After using up all the spiritual crystals, Lu Chen practiced the Soul Refining Technique as he had done a few days ago to increase his soul power and improve his own strength in the shortest possible time.
early morning
When Lu Chen returned to the room in high spirits, Lu Zhan came with food. As soon as he entered the door, he talked about the major events that happened in Tianyuan City last night.
"Brother Chen, I heard that the assassin came out to commit murder again last night, and looted four shops overnight. Now the entire Tianyuan City has been alarmed."
Lu Zhan said while feeding Lu Chen.
Lu Chen smiled and pretended to be stupid and said: "Brother Zhan, four shops were ransacked in one night. The first and second bedrooms couldn't be so angry that they carried it away?"
Lu Zhan said resentfully, "I wanted to see the first and second rooms get so angry that they ran away. Unfortunately, it was not the first and second rooms that the other party looted last night."
Lu Chen is "curious"
Said: "Brother Zhan, didn't you say yesterday that it was the Lu family's turn tonight? We were so anxious that the first and second bedrooms sent additional personnel to guard the house."
Lu Zhan said: "The eleven shops in the first and second rooms were not looted. The assassin ransacked our previous shops last night."
Lu Chen said: "Good guy, the Lin family has just taken over our store, so I guess I'm not even happy yet. Now it's been looted, and it hurts a bit."
Lu Zhan said angrily: "The way they bully you is worse than the first and second bedrooms. That assassin had better loot all the shops in the Lin family."
Lu Chen said: "It should be possible."
"No more."
Lu Zhan shook his head in frustration.
Lu Chen asked: "Brother Zhan, why can't you do it anymore?"
Lu Zhan said: "I heard that this incident has become known throughout the city. Now that the city lord's palace has sent people to investigate, the assassin probably does not dare to commit the crime."
"That's it!"
Lu Chen showed a thoughtful expression.
Now that Yin Dan has broken through to the seventh level of warrior realm, he can fight with all his strength. He has no problem in taking down the intermediate warrior realm, and he can even fight in the high-level warrior realm.
But the City Lord's Palace is the overlord of Tianyuan City. Since they sent people to investigate, the warriors sent out must be martial arts masters, and there is probably more than one person.
The news brought by Lu Zhan made him realize that he had to stop for a while, otherwise if he was caught, he would become a public enemy of Tianyuan City.
"Brother Chen, Brother Chen,..."
Just when Lu Chen was thinking about what to do next, Lu Zhan's voice came to mind again. When Lu Chen came back to his senses, Lu Zhan kept waving a hand in front of his eyes.
Lu Chen said: "What?"
Lu Zhan said: "Brother Chen, what are you thinking about? You are so absorbed in it. I called you several times, but you didn't even answer me."
